strategy.exit_rule: hold to expiry unless stop hit; force-close by Friday ~3pm ET bar regardless

notes: 36-week SPY weekly $6/$6 iron condor, Jan-Sep 2026, real historical Robinhood option prices. 'closes' arrays are hourly last-trade closes from Monday's first bar through expiry-day's last bar.
